Build a complete AI Chat Web App as ONE SINGLE self-contained HTML file named index.html.

IMPORTANT:
- Do NOT use React.
- Do NOT use Vite.
- Do NOT use npm.
- Do NOT create src/main.tsx, package.json, or multiple files.
- Everything must be inside one index.html.
- Use only HTML5, CSS3 and vanilla JavaScript.
- External CDN libraries are allowed only if absolutely necessary.
- The app must work directly by opening index.html in a modern mobile browser.

APP NAME:
Universal AI Chat

MAIN GOAL:
Create a professional ChatGPT-style AI chat application where the user can enter their own API provider, API key, endpoint and model from the 3-dot Settings menu and then chat with that model.

SUPPORTED PROVIDERS:
1. OpenRouter
2. Google Gemini
3. Custom OpenAI-compatible API

The user must NOT be locked to one provider.

--------------------------------------------------
1. MAIN CHAT UI
--------------------------------------------------

Create a clean premium dark mobile-first chat interface.

Top header:
- Hamburger/menu button
- App name: Universal AI
- Current model/provider indicator
- New Chat button
- 3-dot Settings button

Chat area:
- User messages on the right
- AI messages on the left
- Markdown-style formatting
- Code blocks
- Copy button for code
- Copy response button
- Regenerate response
- Stop generating button
- Loading/typing animation
- Error messages displayed clearly
- Auto-scroll while generating
- Smooth message animation

Bottom composer:
- Large text input
- Attach button UI
- Send button
- Enter = send
- Shift + Enter = new line
- Disable send button while empty
- Stop button while AI is generating

Mobile responsive design:
- Must look excellent on Android phones
- No horizontal overflow
- Keyboard-friendly
- Safe-area support
- Bottom composer must remain usable when keyboard opens

--------------------------------------------------
2. THREE-DOT SETTINGS
--------------------------------------------------

When the user taps the 3-dot button, open a premium Settings drawer/modal.

Sections:

API PROVIDER

Provider dropdown:
- OpenRouter
- Google Gemini
- Custom OpenAI Compatible

API KEY:
- Password input
- Show/hide key button
- Never display the complete key after saving

API ENDPOINT:

For OpenRouter default:
https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions

For Gemini:
Use the Gemini REST API endpoint automatically.

For Custom:
Allow the user to enter any OpenAI-compatible chat completion endpoint.

MODEL:

Provide a model text input.

Also provide:
"Load Models" button where possible.

For OpenRouter:
Allow the user to enter/select models such as:
- openai/gpt-4o-mini
- google/gemini-2.5-flash
- meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct
- qwen/qwen3-8b

Do not hardcode these as the only models.
The user must be able to type ANY valid model ID.

For Gemini:
Allow models such as:
- gemini-2.5-flash
- gemini-2.5-pro

Again, model must be editable.

For Custom OpenAI-compatible APIs:
The user can enter any model ID.

--------------------------------------------------
3. API CONNECTION
--------------------------------------------------

Implement actual API calls using fetch().

OpenRouter:
Use:
POST https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions

Headers:
Authorization: Bearer USER_API_KEY
Content-Type: application/json

Body:
{
  model: selectedModel,
  messages: conversationMessages,
  stream: true
}

Support streaming responses if available.

Gemini:
Use the official Gemini REST API format.

Build the request dynamically from:
- API key
- selected Gemini model
- conversation history

Support streaming where the selected Gemini endpoint supports it.

Custom OpenAI-compatible:
Use:
POST userConfiguredEndpoint

Headers:
Authorization: Bearer USER_API_KEY
Content-Type: application/json

Body:
{
  model: selectedModel,
  messages: conversationMessages,
  stream: true
}

If streaming is not supported:
Automatically fall back to normal JSON response.

IMPORTANT:
Do not assume every custom provider supports streaming.

--------------------------------------------------
4. API TEST BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

Inside Settings add:

[ Test Connection ]

When clicked:
- Check API key
- Check endpoint
- Check model
- Send a very small test request
- Show:
  ✓ Connection successful
or
  ✕ Connection failed

Display useful error information without exposing the API key.

--------------------------------------------------
5. SAVE API CONFIGURATION
--------------------------------------------------

Add:

[ Save Configuration ]

Store:
- provider
- endpoint
- model
- API key

Use localStorage.

On app reload:
- Restore the selected provider
- Restore model
- Restore endpoint
- Restore API key

IMPORTANT SECURITY NOTE:
Show a small warning:
"API keys are stored locally in this browser. Do not use this app on a shared/public device."

Never send API keys anywhere except the endpoint selected by the user.

Do not create any backend server.

--------------------------------------------------
6. MULTIPLE API PROFILES
--------------------------------------------------

Allow users to create multiple API profiles.

Example:

OpenRouter - My Account
Gemini - Personal
Custom API - My Server

Buttons:
+ Add Profile
Edit
Delete
Set Active

Each profile stores:
- Name
- Provider
- Endpoint
- API key
- Model

The active profile should appear in the header.

--------------------------------------------------
7. CHAT HISTORY
--------------------------------------------------

Add a left-side menu/drawer containing:

New Chat

Chat History:
- Today
- Yesterday
- Older

Automatically save conversations to localStorage.

Each chat should have:
- Title generated from the first user message
- Date/time
- Delete option
- Rename option

Clicking a history item opens that conversation.

Add:
"Delete All Chats"

Ask for confirmation before deleting all chats.

--------------------------------------------------
8. MODEL SWITCHING
--------------------------------------------------

Add a model selector in Settings.

The user should be able to change models without losing the current conversation.

Example:

Provider:
OpenRouter

Model:
[ google/gemini-2.5-flash ]

Then user can change to:
[ openai/gpt-4o-mini ]

The conversation remains intact.

--------------------------------------------------
9. SYSTEM PROMPT
--------------------------------------------------

Inside Settings add:

System Prompt

Large textarea.

Default:
"You are a helpful AI assistant."

Allow the user to customize it.

Use the system prompt when the selected API supports system messages.

--------------------------------------------------
10. CHAT CONTROLS
--------------------------------------------------

For every AI response provide:

Copy
Regenerate
Delete

For code blocks:
- Copy Code button
- Proper monospace formatting
- Horizontal scrolling only inside code blocks

Support:
- Bold
- Italic
- Headings
- Lists
- Numbered lists
- Inline code
- Code blocks
- Links

Do not execute code returned by the AI.

--------------------------------------------------
11. ERROR HANDLING
--------------------------------------------------

Handle:

Invalid API key
Invalid model
Insufficient credits
Rate limit
Network error
CORS error
Provider unavailable
Malformed response
Streaming failure

Show user-friendly messages.

Example:

"API request failed.
Check your API key, model and endpoint in Settings."

For CORS:
"Your selected provider does not allow browser requests from this app. Use a CORS-enabled endpoint or a backend proxy."

Do not hide errors silently.

--------------------------------------------------
12. SECURITY
--------------------------------------------------

Never hardcode a real API key.

Never send API keys to analytics services.

No tracking.

No external backend.

No fake AI responses.

No simulated model responses.

Every AI answer must come from the configured API.

--------------------------------------------------
13. EXPORT
--------------------------------------------------

Settings should include:

Export Chat
Import Chat
Clear Current Chat

Export current conversation as JSON.

Import JSON conversation.

--------------------------------------------------
14. UI DESIGN
--------------------------------------------------

Premium modern dark interface.

Use:
- Black/very dark background
- Glass-like panels
- Soft borders
- Rounded corners
- Subtle shadows
- Purple/blue accent
- Smooth transitions

Do not make the interface cluttered.

The 3-dot Settings menu should be especially clean.

Settings structure:

API
  Provider
  API Key
  Endpoint
  Model
  Test Connection
  Save Configuration

CHAT
  System Prompt
  Temperature if supported
  Max Tokens if supported

PROFILES
  Saved API Profiles

DATA
  Export Chat
  Import Chat
  Clear Chat
  Delete All Chats

ABOUT
  Universal AI
  Version

--------------------------------------------------
15. IMPORTANT MOBILE BEHAVIOR
--------------------------------------------------

The entire application must be optimized for mobile.

On Android:
- Full viewport
- No page zoom problems
- No horizontal scrolling
- Composer fixed at bottom
- Settings drawer fits screen
- Buttons large enough to tap
- Input remains visible above keyboard
- Use viewport-fit=cover
- Respect env(safe-area-inset-bottom)

--------------------------------------------------
16. NO FAKE FEATURES
--------------------------------------------------

Do NOT create buttons that don't work.

Do NOT create fake model lists pretending to come from an API.

Do NOT create fake streaming.

Do NOT show fake "Connected" status.

Test the actual API configuration.

If an API cannot be accessed directly from browser because of CORS, clearly show the real error.

--------------------------------------------------
17. SINGLE FILE REQUIREMENT
--------------------------------------------------

FINAL OUTPUT MUST BE:

index.html

Everything must be inside this one file:

<html>
  <head>
    CSS
  </head>

  <body>
    UI
    JavaScript
  </body>
</html>

No separate CSS file.
No separate JS file.
No React.
No npm.
No build command.

The finished index.html must be directly usable in a browser.

--------------------------------------------------
18. FINAL QUALITY CHECK
--------------------------------------------------

Before finishing, test all important UI interactions:

- New Chat
- Send message
- Streaming response
- Stop generation
- Regenerate
- Copy response
- Copy code
- 3-dot Settings
- Provider selection
- API key input
- Endpoint input
- Model input
- Test Connection
- Save Configuration
- Multiple profiles
- Model switching
- System prompt
- Chat history
- Rename chat
- Delete chat
- Export
- Import
- Mobile layout

Fix JavaScript errors before delivering the final index.html.

Do not explain the code first.

Generate the complete working single-file index.html.
